title: xf-ingest settings
description: The env file given to `billie kid activate xf-ingest --config <env-file>`, as an object of its keys. BILLIE_INPUT_* come from `billie kid configure`; XF_PACKS, XF_MODELS, XF_OUTPUTS and XF_KID_ID are set by the image.

XF_FROM_FORMAT.description: the input format: a pack named in lookups/input-formats.json

XF_SOURCE_ID.description: the sourceId of every track; CAT062 SAC/SIC is assigned per sourceId

XF_IN_FRAME.description: how one message is delimited (goat-xf-pipe framing); default whole for udp, required for tcp

XF_MULTICAST_GROUP.description: an IPv4 multicast group to join on the listener port

XF_MULTICAST_IFACE.description: the local address of the interface to join the group on

XF_INPUT.description: a goat-xf-pipe input endpoint that replaces the listener, such as tcp://192.0.2.10:4000

XF_TRACK_GENERATION.description: trackGeneration for messages that carry none; default 1

XF_ON_ERROR.description: skip (default): count a message that does not convert and go on
